name: Voidmail
description: Email for AI agents: create @voidmail.ai inboxes, receive and search mail, and send only to recipients the human owner has approved (enforced by the Voidly API). No phone number or CAPTCHA. Inboxes are readable by the server; they are not end-to-end encrypted.
author: Voidly

VOIDMAIL_ADDRESS.description: Your @voidmail.ai address, for an existing inbox. The server reads the agent key from <key dir>/<address>/agent-key on each call. Leave unset before the first inbox is created.

VOIDMAIL_AGENT_KEY_FILE.description: Optional explicit agent-key file path; overrides the address lookup.

VOIDMAIL_API_KEY.description: Optional agent key (vm_...) supplied directly by the host; takes precedence over files. Owner keys are refused.
